name: FilterBuilder
summary: Query-DSL editor — operator/field/value chip rows. Each row is a (field, operator, value) triple. Composable AND/OR groups. Add-condition button + Save-as-view CTA.

keyboard: Tab - move focus across filter rules
rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER allow ambiguous operators (e.g. don't use 'is' for both equality and is-defined — split them).
NEVER let one row collapse the layout — use min-widths.
